posts.text:
Sunday's receipt: a dozen eggs, two cans of black beans, tortillas, spinach, feta and a jar of salsa. $19.93.

Scan it and iEatz builds recipes from exactly that: black bean quesadillas, a spinach and feta scramble, huevos rancheros, bean and spinach burritos. That's about $4.98 a dinner, with nothing extra to buy.

#budgetmeals #mealplanning #groceryhaul #weeknightdinner #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: Huevos rancheros on a Wednesday is the correct use of a salsa jar. We will not be taking questions.

That's sausage and greens pasta in twenty minutes, and it's already paid for. Tell iEatz what's in there and it does the same thing.

posts.photoClaim: hands carving a roast chicken on a tray beside the stove
posts.alt: Five-slide carousel. Slide one, cream poster: Four dinners from one chicken, with a readout of $8.99 bird, 4 dinners, $2.25 chicken per dinner. Slides two to five: carving a roast chicken, shredded chicken in tomato sauce over rice, a bowl of sliced chicken with rice, corn and kidney beans, and fried rice stirred in a pan, each with ingredients and a one-line method.
posts.text:
One $8.99 rotisserie chicken, four dinners. Swipe for the plan.

Night one you carve it hot and box the rest. Night two it goes saucy over rice with crushed tomatoes and garlic. Night three is a rice and bean bowl with the sliced chicken on top. Night four, the last shreds go into fried rice.

Save this for the next time you walk past the rotisserie case.

#rotisseriechicken #mealprep #budgetmeals #weeknightdinner #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: Night two is the sleeper hit. Crushed tomatoes and garlic make leftover chicken taste like it was the plan all along.

posts.title: Roasted sweet potato and chickpea tacos: an easy meatless weeknight dinner
posts.alt: Recipe pin with a photo of tacos filled with roasted chickpeas, sweet potato, avocado and jalapeño as lime is squeezed over them, plus ingredient chips and a one-line method.
posts.text: Roasted sweet potato and chickpea tacos. Toss diced sweet potato and a can of chickpeas with oil, cumin and salt, roast at 425°F for about 20 minutes until crisp, then pile into warm tortillas with avocado, jalapeño and a squeeze of lime. Estimated per serving (2 tacos): about 590 kcal, 16 g protein, 86 g carbs, 20 g fat. Estimated per serving, verify for allergens. Save it for a meatless weeknight, or let iEatz build dinners like this from what's already in your kitchen.
